copy.tagline: 生成财务报告，包含KPI、损益表和展望
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要定期制作公司财务报告
copy.tagline_en: Generate financial reports with KPIs, P&L, and outlook
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create regular financial reports for your company

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会生成一份结构化季度财报，包含公司名称、季度、报告标题、4个关键KPI、收入与烧钱图表、盈亏概要表、5条重点摘要、展望段落和可折叠的方法论区域。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 生成季度财报或财务报告时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一份Q2季度财报，包含收入和烧钱图表。
写一份公司季度P&L报告，带KPI重点。
生成财务报告，加上展望和方法论说明。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will generate a structured quarterly financial report with company name, quarter, report title, 4 hero KPIs, revenue and burn charts, P&L summary table, 5 top-line highlights, outlook paragraph, and collapsible methodology section.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to generate a quarterly financial report or finance report.

say_en.text: Generate a Q2 quarterly report with revenue and burn charts.
Create a quarterly P&L report with KPI highlights.
say_en.note: Includes P&L table and 5 bullet points.

say_en.text: Generate a financial report with outlook and methodology.
